'''M4-Y10''' was a small [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] present on<ref name="May4" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="May4" /> in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had [[Color/Legends|black]] plating and [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] along with a red [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] and stripes across its three [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and on the left side of its body. The right side had a white stripe. M4-Y10 had a cylindrical body and a wider round head.<ref name="May4" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This astromech earned its designation from The Old Republic's 10-year anniversary, coming in December of this year. M4-Y10 is special in that it draws the inspiration for its appearance from The Bad Batch!|Announcement description for M4-Y10|<ref name="May4" />}}
M4-Y10 was announced on [[April 30]], [[2021]] to appear<ref name="May4" /> in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> The droid was offered as a free gift minipet to players who logged in between [[May 4]]&mdash;known as [[Star Wars|''Star Wars'' Day]]&mdash;and [[May 11]], 2021. The droid's name was made in reference to the date and the 10 year anniversary of ''The Old Republic'' in [[December]] 2021. Its appearance is based on the [[canon]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'',<ref name="May4" /> which [[Aftermath (episode)|premiered]] on [[May]] 4,<ref name="Airdate">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> in which the characters of [[Clone Force 99]] wear similarly-[[color]]ed [[Katarn-class commando armor|armor]].<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref>
